title: Surcharge on the Monthly Rate Where the Building's Maintenance Account Is Behind
content:
# Surcharge on the Monthly Rate Where the Building's Maintenance Account Is Behind

Arrears elsewhere in the building's file weigh on the late fee rate of a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects.

## Rule

Where the Preventive Maintenance Agreement covering the building stands suspended and carries an unpaid balance, the arrears surcharge of **0.5 percentage points** is added to the monthly rate.

Where the Preventive Maintenance Agreement covering the building stands active and carries an unpaid balance, the mild surcharge of **0.25 percentage points** is added to the monthly rate.

Where the maintenance agreement covering the building carries no unpaid balance, or the building carries no maintenance agreement at all, nothing is added to the monthly rate: **0 percentage points**.

## Reading the agreement

The agreement read is the one covering the same building under the company's Preventive Maintenance Agreements, and what is read of it is its standing and the balance it owes. Both the standing and an unpaid balance must be present for a surcharge to arise; an agreement in any other standing than suspended or active, or one owing nothing, adds nothing.

| Maintenance agreement at the building | Unpaid balance on it | Added to the monthly rate |
|---|---|---|
| suspended | yes | 0.5 percentage points |
| active | yes | 0.25 percentage points |
| suspended or active | none | nothing |
| none at the building | — | nothing |

## Worked rates (hypothetical, class rate 1.25 per cent per month)

A building whose maintenance agreement stands suspended and owing carries a monthly rate of 1.75 per cent; one whose agreement stands active and owing carries 1.5 per cent; one whose agreement owes nothing carries 1.25 per cent.
